checklists.name: Kotlin Android Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Kotlin Android Coroutines, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, and ProGuard/R8 obfuscation.

items.statement: Coroutines manage lifecycle cancellation via viewModelScope / lifecycleScope and avoid GlobalScope usages.
Jetpack Compose UI components minimize recompositions via Stable / Immutable data models.
ktlint and detekt static analysis tools enforce Kotlin coding conventions and prevent code smells.
Room database migrations include explicit test cases for version upgrades.
ProGuard / R8 rules are verified to ensure release builds obfuscate code without stripping necessary reflection targets.

obligationDefinitions.title: Gradle dependency vulnerabilities and Android API deprecations must be tracked
obligationDefinitions.description: A Kotlin/Android project's Gradle dependencies must be scanned for known vulnerabilities, and usages of deprecated Android APIs tracked, so both are remediated on a recurring cadence rather than discovered only at the next target-SDK bump.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every Critical/High dependency vulnerability and deprecated-API usage is remediated or tracked within SLA.

requiredEvidence.title: Dependency/deprecation scan
requiredEvidence.description: Gradle dependency vulnerability scan plus Android lint deprecation report.
